UNION PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
PRESS RELEASE: FINAL RESULT OF CIVIL SERVICES EXAMINATION, 2026

Based on the results of the written part of Civil Services Examination, 2026 held by the Union Public Service Commission in September 2026 and the interviews for Personality Test held in January-March 2027, following is the list, in order of merit, of candidates who have been recommended for appointment to:
(i) Indian Administrative Service;
(ii) Indian Foreign Service;
(iii) Indian Police Service; and
(iv) Central Services, Group 'A' and Group 'B'.
A total number of 1020 candidates have been recommended for appointment.
The final result along with merit list is published for general information.
